meta.doctrine: an entry is live only if a real fetch in the discovery run returned the board's postings JSON; calibration probes (one gibberish token per provider) were run first and their signatures recorded here
meta.discovery_accounting: Two tranches, both 2026-10-14. Tranche 1 (corpus lists + registry + first slug pass): 953 probe outcomes (465 dead, 94 live, 26 unverifiable, 368 transport errors) -> directory v1, 91 entries / 89 watchable. Tranche 2 (the completed employer-slug sweep for the four supported providers, 1,310 candidates): an initial pass over 1,055 of them found 25 live boards but its records were lost when the sandbox /tmp was wiped; the sweep was therefore re-probed in full into durable storage (1,310 outcomes: 483 dead, 145 unverifiable, 662 transport errors, 20 live) and merged live-beats-non-live over v1. Directory v2: 109 entries, 107 watchable. The probe_stats block counts only the merged v2 record file (v1 entries carried as verified-live records + tranche-2 outcomes); tranche-1's non-live outcomes survive in the day's reports, not in this file. The Phase-3 watch proof ran over v1's 89 boards; the 18 net-new v2 boards are verified live by discovery fetches (the directory standard) but were not in that watch window.

egress2_mi034.note: Corpus-egress continuation (run 9): resumed Corpus 3A's untested board candidates. 3A's exact candidate list was never persisted (2026-10-14 egress outages + VM restart), so the pool was REGENERATED from 3A's recorded methodology (employer names in its priority non-tech classes -> concatenated + hyphenated slugs x Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby, extended to SmartRecruiters per run 8's 4-provider standard) using board-discovery.py's persisted employer universe plus a supplementary priority-class list, excluding every (provider, token) already live or already probed by run 8 (1,238 excluded: 63 already live, 1,175 already probed). 3,489 candidates probed: live 47 / dead 2,461 / unverifiable 981 (all SmartRecruiters) / transport-error 0 in the final accounting. Calibration first, gibberish token per provider, identical in both probe parts: Greenhouse 404/dead, Lever 404/dead, Ashby 404/dead, SmartRecruiters 200/unverifiable. HTTP 429 never occurred; no provider hard-stopped. Mid-run the first probe process was killed when egress collapsed (its final 34 records are http=0 transport errors across all four providers at once, preserved verbatim in egress2.jsonl); a resume pass re-probed those 34 plus the 2,318 never-probed (2,352 records in egress2-resume.jsonl) and every one reached a conclusive verdict, so raw records total 3,523 with 34 superseded errors. A board is live only on a real postings-JSON fetch this run. Per-board fetch records: docs/career/board-egress2-probes/{egress2,egress2-resume}.jsonl (every probed candidate named with its verdict). Token-label overrides: seven 0-posting boards (ashby ondeck/project44, greenhouse coursehero/greenpeace/mit, lever blueorigin/mit) are real but unattributable from zero postings — labeled by token per the run-8 apollo precedent; all 40 other new boards' postings were spot-checked against their company hints and support them. Tyson Foods on the four supported providers: tysonfoods/tyson/tyson-foods all dead or unverifiable (in the probe records) — no supported board; its Workday board stays NOT_WIRED (four CXS total probes this run returned HTTP 303 with empty bodies — no total obtained, recorded as transport evidence only; the corpus pull3-portals.jsonl still holds its 412 banked postings, remainder unpulled). The 27 HTTP-422 Workday tenants stay NOT_WIRED — recorded, not wired. Live 262 -> 309; 691 boards remain to 1,000.
